en.dev.eclipse.doc.credits.start: Runs the REAL final credits sequence for everyone online: helm shot, whiteout teleport to the epilogue beach, sunrise auto-run with the credits roll, lightning + debris, title cards, fade home. On a dedicated server an un-skipped run ends with every client closing and the server halting.
en.dev.eclipse.doc.credits.skip: Jumps a running credits sequence to the outro and permanently disarms the client-close/server-halt for that run (the QA escape hatch).
en.dev.eclipse.credits.already_running: The credits sequence is already running — use /dev credits skip to bail out.
en.dev.eclipse.credits.start_blocked: Credits could not start: creditsEnabled=false or the eclipse:epilogue dimension is missing (see the server log).
en.dev.eclipse.credits.started: Final credits sequence started (dedicated servers: ends with client close + server halt unless skipped).
en.dev.eclipse.credits.skipped: Credits skipped to the outro — the close/halt is disarmed for this run.
